name: Hoshino Iroha
source:
A time-traveling girl from the future who appeared after the “Pure Song Garden” tests.

Her appearance closely resembles the popular virtual idol “Ai,” but she herself insists she is a human girl.

With nowhere to go, nowhere to stay, and no money (basically nothing at all) she was taken in by Kanata and the others.

Having come to the past, Iroha is endlessly curious.

She reacts to everything with surprise, joy, and big laughter.

She lacks a lot of common sense and is a bit out of touch, so if left alone there’s no telling what she might do... yet that recklessness is also part of what makes her cute.

“As for me, just let me sit quietly in a corner of the living room and I’ll be fine.”
